nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a Chernikov group, that is, a group with a normal subgroup of finite index isomorphic to a direct product of finitely many quasicyclic groups (infinite abelian groups all of whose proper subgroups are finite). Suppose that $G$ does not contain a direct product of two quasicyclic groups over the same prime: there is no quasicyclic group $Q$ with an injective homomorphism $Q \times Q \to G$. Then the…
nodes.title: Subgroup lattices of Chernikov groups without a quasicyclic square have finite dimension

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every Chernikov group $G$ that does not contain a direct product of two quasicyclic groups over the same prime (that is, there is no quasicyclic group $Q$ with an injective homomorphism $Q \times Q \to G$), the lattice of subgroups of $G$ has finite order dimension: the inclusion order on the subgroups of $G$ is the intersection of finitely many linear orders on that set. nodes.title: Shevrin's problem on the dimension of subgroup lattices of Chernikov groups

nodes.summary: A group $G$ contains a direct product of two quasicyclic groups over the same prime when there are a quasicyclic group $Q$ and an injective group homomorphism $Q \times Q \to G$ (quasicyclic groups over the same prime are isomorphic).
nodes.title: Groups containing the square of a quasicyclic group

nodes.summary: A partially ordered set has finite (order) dimension: its order relation is the intersection of finitely many linear orders on the same set.
nodes.title: Poset of finite order dimension

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is a Chernikov group if it has a normal subgroup of finite index that is isomorphic to a direct product $Q_1 \times \dots \times Q_r$ of finitely many quasicyclic groups $Q_1, \dots, Q_r$. The case $r = 0$ is allowed, so every finite group is a Chernikov group.
nodes.title: Chernikov group

nodes.summary: A group $Q$ is quasicyclic if it is abelian and infinite and every proper subgroup of $Q$ is finite.
nodes.title: Quasicyclic group

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved

stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
